title: Revenue by airline
statementMd:
Total booking fares per airline name, rounded to 2 decimals, biggest first.

Expected columns: `name`, `revenue`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.name, ROUND(SUM(b.fare), 2) AS revenue FROM bookings b JOIN flights f ON f.id = b.flight_id JOIN airlines a ON a.code = f.airline_code GROUP BY a.code, a.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
